meta.name: bedrock-auth-acceptance
meta.description: Acceptance hank for AWS Bedrock support: one run exercises both runtimes and both model families. Codon 1 (Anthropic-on-Bedrock, unprefixed) must run on the Claude Agent SDK in Bedrock mode; codon 2 is the explicit pi/ override of the same model; codon 3 (DeepSeek on Bedrock) always runs on pi. Prompts are deliberately trivial — the suite verifies auth and routing, not model capability. DeepSeek is deepseek.v3.2, NOT us.deepseek.r1-v1:0: R1 on Bedrock rejects toolConfig outright (400 'This model doesn't support tool use'), so it can never serve a coding-agent codon.

hank.name: Haiku on Bedrock via Claude Agent SDK
hank.promptText: Create the file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/haiku-agent-sdk.txt containing exactly the word OK. Do nothing else.

hank.name: Haiku on Bedrock via explicit pi override
hank.promptText: Create the file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/haiku-pi.txt containing exactly the word OK. Do nothing else.

hank.name: DeepSeek V3.2 on Bedrock via pi
hank.promptText: Use the write tool to create the file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/deepseek-pi.txt containing exactly the word OK. One tool call, nothing else.
